'''Heavy Gan's Movers''' was a local [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] ring that supplied rare goods and contraband to the wealthy citizens of [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]]. Their leader, [[Heavy Gan]], was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who ruled his operation with cunning and intimidation.<ref name="Lure of the Lost" />

==Behind the scenes==
Heavy Gan's Movers first appeared in ''[[Lure of the Lost]]'', a downloadable [[Fantasy Flight Games]] [[roleplaying game]] module released [[June 18]], [[2015]].
